caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with cabriole legs and a high, ornate backrest featuring a central, inward-curved panel. The chair's frame is rendered in various shades of reddish-brown, suggesting polished wood, with visible grain patterns and curved detailing along the arms and legs. Each armrest ends in a scroll design. The seat is upholstered with a light greenish-yellow fabric that appears patterned, contrasting softly against the wood. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Armchair
